title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Themeisle Feedzy…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Themeisle Feedzy plugin (feedzy-rss-feeds) up to version 5.2.15. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts that can be stored and executed in users' browsers.
